header.title: List
header.description: Vertical index of text, icons, avatars and actions. Built from an `items` array: rows, separators and subheaders. Rows can be selected, open nested items, hold a checkbox or switch and a secondary action.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the list and its code. Click a row to select it.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Each item needs an `id` and a `label`. `{ type: "separator" }` adds a divider line. Rows are buttons by default.

icons.title: With icons
icons.description: `icon` adds a leading icon. `bordered` wraps the list in a border.

folders.title: With description
folders.description: `description` adds a second line under the `label`.

nested.title: Nested
nested.description: `items` inside an item turns it into a disclosure. `defaultOpen` opens it initially. The chevron rotates when open.

selected.title: Selection
selected.description: `value` and `onChange` control the selected row; `defaultValue` sets it uncontrolled. The chosen row gets `aria-current`.

avatars.title: With avatar
avatars.description: `avatar` replaces the icon. Give the `Avatar` `alt=""` because the name is already in the `label`.

alignStart.title: Align start
alignStart.description: With three or more lines, use `align: "start"` so the avatar stays at the top. `divided` separates rows with a line.

messages.subject: Brunch this weekend?
messages.preview: I'll be in your neighborhood doing errands, want to grab breakfast?

messages.subject: Summer BBQ
messages.preview: To Scott, Alex and Jennifer: wish I could come, but I'm out of town that weekend.

checkboxes.title: Checkboxes
checkboxes.description: `type: "checkbox"` adds a checkbox and the whole row toggles it. `checked` and `onCheckedChange` control the state.

secondaryCheckbox.title: Checkbox at the end
secondaryCheckbox.description: `controlPlacement: "end"` puts the checkbox at the end. There it's a separate control: the row and the checkbox are two different targets.

switches.title: Switches
switches.description: `type: "switch"` adds a trailing switch. The whole row toggles it.

secondaryAction.title: Secondary action
secondaryAction.description: `secondaryAction` adds a trailing element, like an icon button. It's a separate target: its click doesn't activate the row. Try deleting a file.

sticky.title: Sticky subheaders
sticky.description: `{ type: "subheader", sticky: true }` sticks to the top while the list scrolls. It needs `maxHeight` so the list scrolls.

inset.title: Inset
inset.description: `inset` adds start padding so a row without an icon lines up with rows that have one. It works on separators too.

gutterless.title: Gutterless
gutterless.description: `disableGutters` removes horizontal padding on every row; you can also set it per item. Useful when the list sits in a container with its own padding.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes padding, type scale and icon size.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` disables one item. `isDisabled` disables the whole list.

header.title: List API
header.description: API reference for the React List component: list and item props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `ListItem` types the `items` array.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: List accepts <ul> attributes except children, onChange and defaultValue, which mean something else here. They go to the root along with ref. style is merged with --gem-list-max-h when you pass maxHeight.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.semantics: The root is a <ul> and each row an <li>. Subheaders are text, not headings.
a11y.rows: A plain row is a <button> and the selected one has aria-current="true". With href it's an <a> with aria-current="page". With secondaryAction it's a div with role="button" that responds to Enter and Space.
a11y.nested: An item with items has aria-expanded and aria-controls. The closed panel has aria-hidden and inert.
a11y.controls: Checkbox and switch are real inputs. At the start (or always, for switch) the row is their <label>. Without a string label or ariaLabel, they're named "Select" or "Toggle".
a11y.secondary: secondaryAction is a separate target. If it's an icon button, give it an aria-label.
a11y.names: The row uses ariaLabel or the string label as aria-label, so the description isn't announced. If the label is a node, pass ariaLabel.
a11y.disabled: Disabled rows are disabled buttons; links use aria-disabled and leave the tab order.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root `<ul>`. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Sets the sizing variables.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Adds a border and clips the corners.
rules.divided: Applied with `divided`. Adds a line between rows.
rules.label: Label. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.control: Checkbox or switch wrapper. `--end` when trailing.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: List's own variables. The size and radius classes set them, so use `.gem-list.your-class` to override them.

items.--gem-list-icon: Icon slot size. Also sets the `inset` indent.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The list also accepts `<ul>` attributes (see Inheritance). Items are objects inside `items`.

items.onChange: Fires when a selectable row (no nested items or control) is activated.
items.onAction: Fires when any row is activated, including links.
items.onCheckedChange: Fires when a checkbox or switch changes.
items.bordered: Adds a border around the list.
items.disableGutters: Removes horizontal padding on every row.
items.maxHeight: Max height with scrolling. A number is taken as pixels.

items.id: Stable key for selection, ids and callbacks.
items.label: Main text.
items.control: Explicit control. Inferred from `type` by default.
items.controlPlacement: Where the control sits. Defaults to `start` for checkbox and `end` for switch.
items.items: Nested items. The row becomes a disclosure.
items.href: Turns the row into a link.
items.secondaryAction: Trailing element, separate from the row.
items.selected: Marks the row as current. Prefer the list `value`.
items.inset: Adds start padding to line up with rows that have an icon.
items.disableGutters: Removes horizontal padding on this row.
items.align: Vertical alignment of the leading slot. Use `start` with three or more lines.
items.onClick: Fires when the row is activated.
items.onCheckedChange: Fires when this row's control changes.

items.separator: Divider line. `inset` aligns it with the text.
items.subheader: Section title. `sticky` pins it while scrolling.
